 Emlyn Begley
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 20:27 GMT 20:27 GMT 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Strikers Thierno Barry and William Osula have each had the joint fewest touches in the opening 25 minutes of this game (two each).
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Not a great deal of quality so far published at 20:26 GMT 20:26 GMT 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 John Anderson 
Former Newcastle defender on BBC Radio Newcastle 
 There's been a lot of endeavour but not a great deal of quality so far. 
 Neither side can keep the ball. 
 Everything is rushed. 
 23 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 26 mins 26 mins 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Tyrique George shoots over for Everton from distance. Boss David Moyes gets out of his seat to dish out some instructions.
 9 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:25 GMT 20:25 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Newcastle game plan. Thump it long and hope when Everton have a bunch of giants at the back. Pathetic. It’s gonna be a long night.
 Rob, London 
 This Newcastle team will struggle this season until they get a ball carrier in midfield. Sean Steur should be given his chance.
 Dave, North East 
 78 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:25 GMT 20:25 GMT 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Thierno Barry has only scored three of his 28 shots in the Premier League this season. 
 20 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 25 mins 25 mins 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Big chance for Everton here. Jarrad Branthwaite nods the ball down to Thierno Barry, who misjudges the bounce and volleys Will Osula's arm more than he does the ball. He was only about eight yards out there.
 45 59 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Poor effort from Rohl published at 20:22 GMT 20:22 GMT 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 John Anderson 
Former Newcastle defender on BBC Radio Newcastle 
 Wasn’t really a shot, was it? 
 It was a poor effort. 
 Did he try to chip him? 
 Poor effort, thankfully for Newcastle.
 70 55 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21 mins 21 mins 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Good move from Everton. Tyrique George crosses, Newcastle don't clear it and Thierno Barry - with his first touch of the game 20 minutes in - finds amateur photographer Merlin Rohl, who shoots over the bar.
 67 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 The game is lacking fluidity published at 20:19 GMT 20:19 GMT 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 John Anderson 
Former Newcastle defender on BBC Radio Newcastle 
 There’s not a great deal of fluidity to the game is there? From either side. 
 68 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19 mins 19 mins 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Harvey Barnes nearly picks out Will Osula in the box but the Toon striker can't quite take it in his stride.
 62 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17 mins 17 mins 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 A lot of pushing and shoving from Newcastle's resulting corner and captain Dan Burn heads wide at the far post.
 84 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17 mins 17 mins 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Newcastle's first chance of the game. Amar Dedic gets into the box and picks out Joelinton, who turns and shoots with a powerful effort from the edge of the box but it's deflected wide.
 114 26 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16 mins 16 mins 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Newcastle have a free-kick - with Dan Burn going forward - and they then play it short and Amar Dedic pings it out of play.
 81 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14 mins 14 mins 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 This game really has not come to life yet. Anthony Elanga drops back to tackle Tyrique George and win a free-kick for Newcastle.
 80 46 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 12 mins 12 mins 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Will Osula goes out to the left for Newcastle and whips in a cross which is deflected by a defender and then caught by Jordan Pickford.
 113 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 11 mins 11 mins 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Nobody puts any pressure on Everton keeper Jordan Pickford as he just walks around with the ball outside his box, following Lewis Hall's long ball.
 101 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Newcastle fans are not happy' published at 20:09 GMT 20:09 GMT 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Andy Hinchcliffe 
Former Man City and Everton defender on Sky Sports 
 Really positive start from Everton.
 The Newcastle fans are not happy, their team are just not dominating.
 218 76 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 9 mins 9 mins 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Everton's second effort off target - this time it's Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall who could have made better contact with a shot that goes wide.
 93 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Pickford got his angles all right published at 20:08 GMT 20:08 GMT 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 John Anderson 
Former Newcastle defender on BBC Radio Newcastle 
 Got his angles all right didn’t he? Knew exactly where it was going Pickford. Knew it was drifting wide. 
 The problem for Osula is when you’re drifting in on that left hand side and you hit it with your right, you’ve got to hit it perfectly. 
 77 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:07 GMT 20:07 GMT 
 Newcastle 0-0 Everton 
 Neil Johnston 
BBC Sport football reporter at St James' Park 
 Image source, Getty Images Harvey Barnes is making his 100th Premier League appearance for Newcastle tonight. The winger very nearly scored the 100th goal of his career.
